emotion.instructions: Does the headline express feelings or emotional reactions about {subject}, such as joy, hope, pride, anger, frustration, fear, disappointment, grief or relief? Ignore navigation, ads and related-story links.

movement.instructions: Does the headline report current transfers, trades, loans, signings, departures, contract negotiations or coaching changes involving {subject}? Include rumours and denials. Exclude historical background, fantasy trades, navigation and related-story links.

subject.instructions: Is {subject} substantively involved in the headline's reporting? An opponent or directly affected club can qualify. A passing historical comparison, navigation entry, ad or related-story link alone does not qualify.

note: Headline-only decisions before publisher acquisition. Three subject-scoped scores; Scout uses measurements. Existing topic cutoffs remain conservative canary candidates.
